generationMethod: xAI Chat Completions API via authenticated Mac mini

variations.name: Folio
variations.rationale: Print-magazine masthead: cream stock, serif display, issue well plus sticky rail. A reading bar and in-issue index choreograph scroll without hiding copy.

variations.name: Title Block
variations.rationale: Architectural drawing board: measured grid, CAD title block, plan of career rooms. A crosshair HUD and keyboard-cycled spaces make the sheet feel spatial.

variations.name: Nocturne
variations.rationale: Night-sky editorial: gold on near-black, CSS constellation, chapters as star points. Scroll tightens the name; keyboard walks the sky without trapping the page.

variations.name: Twin Plate
variations.rationale: Split plate: engineer and operator share one sheet. A draggable seam and two modes reweight the same facts; vertical identity type holds the axis.

variations.name: Hot Metal
variations.rationale: Poster type as architecture: acid field, overlapping display letters that magnetize to the pointer, a marching focus slug, and stamp-like facts. Loud on purpose.
